title: Incorporating a church to avoid the Vietnam draft

tellings.quote: And we incorporated the Ottophilis Savonic Orthodox Church of North and South America incorporated

plain: In 1968 in the Bronx, New York, the author Peter Levenda and others legally incorporated a church to avoid being drafted for the Vietnam War. Levenda tells Michels this himself, and says they called it the "Ottophilis Savonic Orthodox Church of North and South America," as the name comes through on the show. It is his own story of a young man finding a way around the draft.
